linkedinAbout.label: LinkedIn About (personal — no TTM)
linkedinAbout.text:
I'm ComicCoder23, based in the Glasgow / Central Scotland area, looking for IT help desk / 1st line support roles in Scotland.

I bring years of customer service and sales — outbound and inbound phones, targets, calm under pressure — plus recent hands-on Windows support helping family with real PC problems: setup, fixes, and clear explanations without jargon. I'm rebuilding into tech through free learning and small public builds under ComicCoder23, using AI-assisted coding carefully with docs and proof rather than overclaiming.

My education grounding includes a Computing Certificate (SCQF Level 7) with units in operating systems, computer architecture, IT applications, and software development planning (certificated 2004), plus earlier NC-level computing and IT study in the Lanarkshire / Hamilton college pathway. I also undertook further technical-support training beyond that certificate; I do not claim an HND.

I'm strongest on people, phones, patience, and getting stuck systems working again. Open to permanent or contract 1st line / service desk roles across Glasgow and central Scotland (hybrid welcome).

Featured / links (personal only): GitHub — ComicCoder23. No TTM links.
